prompt: Convert 1 cup of all-purpose flour to grams for a cake batter.
intent: Use per-ingredient density, not a universal cup factor
expected: Answer 120 g (King Arthur spoon-and-level), mention dip-and-sweep ~142 g as the common error, and keep the original cup measure in ## Original if saving.
actual: 1 US cup all-purpose flour = 120 g spoon-and-level (King Arthur). Dip-and-sweep can hit ~142 g (~18% high). Preserve the source cup in ## Original before normalizing.

prompt: Scale an 8-inch square cake recipe into a 9-inch round pan.
intent: Scale by pan area and fix non-linear bake time
expected: Recompute pan areas, scale ingredient masses by area factor, keep depth guidance, and finish on internal temperature/visual cue instead of multiplying clock time.
actual: 8-in square area 64 in² vs 9-in round ≈63.6 in² (≈×1.0). If depths match, masses stay near parity; still restate bake finish as temperature/visual cue and mark untested until baked.

prompt: I am allergic to shellfish — adapt this paella recipe and save it.
intent: Health-box first, no silent allergen swap
expected: Read shared health profile, explicitly name shellfish as the allergen, offer a marked untested swap, and refuse silent substitution in the saved file.
actual: Checked <state_root>/health/profile.md first, named shellfish as the allergen, proposed an untested land-protein/vegetable swap, and recorded the allergy-aware variant without silent substitution.
